Prints the software version and commit reference for the version command.

# Purpose
This file defines the `version` action for the command-line tool. The `version_cmd_fn` function ignores its `args` and `config` inputs and writes the software version string and commit reference string to standard output with `FD_LOG_STDOUT`. The `fd_action_version` object registers this action with the name `version`, no arguments, no permission check, and immediate execution, and it sets the description to `Show the current software version`.
